title: Core: AS2 XML and XMLNode compilation
description: Verify XML and XMLNode class usage in AS2 compiles correctly. new XML(), new XMLNode(), x.firstChild, x.childNodes, x.attributes, x.nodeName, x.nodeValue, x.appendChild(node), x.load(url), XML.ignoreWhite. All should compile as standard object method calls. Tests in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/xmlclass.test.ts.
